mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, is_active, create_time, update_time FROM chat_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY update_time DESC
SELECT id, user_id, title, is_active, create_time, update_time FROM chat_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY update_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_session (user_id, title, is_active, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{isActive}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE cs, cm FROM chat_session cs LEFT JOIN chat_message cm ON cs.id = cm.session_id WHERE cs.id = #{sessionId}
